errors.error_description: Declared an escaped identifier named after a keyword: logic [WIDTH-1:0] \always_comb ; uses a reserved word as an identifier.
The combinational always block's sensitivity list omits signals that are read inside (en, d2, d3), leading to a mismatch.
Implemented the 4:1 mux with unnecessary deep nested if-else chains, creating suboptimal combinational paths instead of a simple case.
Mixed blocking and non-blocking assignments to the same register y_reg within a single sequential block, creating a race condition.
